tldr: Global stock markets experienced a slump, driven by a broad sell-off in the artificial intelligence sector following Anthropic's public trading debut.
The US Senate passed bipartisan legislation aimed at accelerating permitting reviews for energy and data center infrastructure projects.
The US officially lost its measles elimination status, as the Pan American Health Organization reclassified the disease as endemic in the nation.

market.why: Global stock markets closed lower, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite both declining, as investors questioned the significant investments in AI and a broader sell-off impacted the sector after Anthropic's initial public offering.

yield_10y.why: The articles do not provide a specific reason for the 10-year Treasury yield's minor change on November 19, 2026.

vix.why: The VIX, a measure of market volatility, increased as global stock markets slumped and the AI sector experienced a sell-off, indicating heightened investor apprehension.

watchlist.read: Mid-range - 7% of the way up its 1-month band. Big session: down 8.0% in a day.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate increased to 7.28% in the weekly Freddie Mac survey released on November 19, 2026. This rate tracks the direction of 10-year Treasury yields over recent days, though a specific reason for this weekly change was not detailed in the provided articles.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_upcoming.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA conforming loan limit for next year — expected late November
policy_calendar.note: The cap on a conforming (non-jumbo) mortgage, and the line between a normal rate and a jumbo one. FHFA has announced it in the last days of November each year, and the new limit applies to loans made from January 1.

tech.summary: Shares of AI company Anthropic slumped on its second day of trading, dragging down the broader AI market, as investors reassessed the large sums being invested in artificial intelligence development.
A new CPU architecture named 'Frostbite' has been discovered, designed, and verified entirely by artificial intelligence, marking a significant development in AI's role in hardware engineering.

Signal is implementing restrictions to block AI agents like Gemini and Siri from reading user messages and other data by preventing screenshots on Android and iOS devices, aiming to uphold user privacy.

world.summary: The UK and EU have agreed to a 'reset deal' for their relationship, although the issue of tuition fees for EU students attending UK universities remains unresolved.
Nearly 600 women were killed in South Africa within a three-month period, prompting police officials to call for increased efforts to prevent violence against women and children.

Reports indicate that almost one-third of all reported violations against children worldwide in 2025 occurred in Palestine, as Palestinians return to find their homes in ruins following Israel's ground offensive.

us.summary: The US Senate approved bipartisan legislation aimed at speeding up permitting reviews for the construction of power plants, transmission lines, and other energy infrastructure, including data centers.

The US Army postponed its plan to detonate a stash of bomb-making chemicals in south-eastern Iowa following public and state official concerns that the controlled detonation could release a cloud of lead particles.
A Texas execution took over an hour as staff struggled to find suitable veins for the lethal injection, with the prisoner, Reinaldo Dennes, reportedly moaning about pain.

science.summary: A daily pill called daraxonrasib has shown potential to shrink and possibly eliminate tumors in some patients with pancreatic cancer, offering significant hope for one of the deadliest forms of the disease.

The US has officially lost its measles elimination status, as the Pan American Health Organization announced that the disease is now considered endemic in the country after a strain lingered for over a year.
